problem_statement: Build a brand-new /work page from scratch on the Reactfolio personal-portfolio site (truethari__reactfolio__7429ed872c8b, React 18 + react-router-dom v6 + Create-React-App, styled with plain CSS and CSS custom properties). The route /work does not exist in the baseline (it renders empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system: the shared NavBar (with a new 'Work' item marked active) and Footer, the site's page-content/content-wrapper shell, the fixed circular Logo, and the shared .title/.subtitle typography. The page shows a work-history timeline: a hero title 'Where I've made an impact along the way.' with an intro subtitle, a row of discipline filter buttons (All Roles / Engineering / Product / Design, each carrying a data-filter attribute), a section heading (h3) that reflects the active filter plus a count of positions, and a responsive two-column grid of role cards (each with a duration, company name, role title and a short blurb). Inline the work-item data as a static array in the page (no network fetch). Wire the filter buttons as a genuine interaction: clicking a discipline updates BOTH the visible role cards AND the section heading (e.g. clicking 'Engineering' shows only engineering roles under an 'Engineering Roles' heading). The page must have no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: Reuse the shared NavBar with a new 'Work' nav item and Footer, inside the site's page-content/content-wrapper shell with the fixed circular Logo
A hero using the shared .title class reading 'Where I've made an impact along the way.' and a .subtitle intro line
A filter button row with four buttons: 'All Roles', 'Engineering', 'Product', 'Design' (each carrying a data-filter attribute)
A section heading (h3) that reads 'All Roles' by default and a count badge showing the number of positions
A responsive two-column grid of role cards, each with a duration, company name, an h?/p role title and a short blurb
Static inlined work-item data (no live API/fetch)
Clicking a discipline filter updates the visible cards AND the section heading (e.g. 'Engineering' -> 'Engineering Roles')
The shared site Footer reused at the bottom
No horizontal overflow at mobile width

Filter buttons use pill styling: border-radius 20px, padding ~8px 18px; the active button has background --primary-color (#27272a / rgb(39,39,42)) with white text (rgb(255,255,255)), inactive buttons have a white background with muted text --secondary-color (#65656d / rgb(101,101,109)); font-family Heebo
Section heading text is 'All Roles' by default with a count badge reading '<n> positions' (e.g. '6 positions')

Include at least one role card with company 'Facebook', duration '2021 - PRESENT' and role title 'Senior Software Engineer' (an engineering discipline role), plus another engineering role such as 'Backend Engineer' at 'Twitter' (2019 - 2021)
Cards use border-radius 20px, ~15px padding, Heebo font at ~16px
design_constraints: Reuse the CSS custom properties in src/data/styles.css (--primary-color #27272a, --secondary-color #65656d, --link-color #14b8a6, --primary-font Heebo, --secondary-font Roboto)
Reuse the shared components NavBar, Footer, Logo and the .page-content/.content-wrapper/.title/.subtitle classes
Match the existing projects/articles page mold (fixed logo, content-wrapper, page-footer) and the responsive @media (max-width:600px) collapse to one column

Reference palette tokens (match these so colors overlap the reference): active-filter background rgb(39,39,42), filter text rgb(101,101,109), link/accent rgb(20,184,166); page background white rgb(255,255,255) on a light (#f9f9f9) page

Hero title uses the shared .title class and reads exactly 'Where I've made an impact along the way.'; the filter section renders four pill buttons in a single row: All Roles / Engineering / Product / Design
